paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представлява групирана стълбовидна визуализация за сравнение на точност (Accuracy) в проценти за шест конфигурации на reinforcement learning метода върху три бенчмарка. Категориите са разположени по хоризонталната ос и са означени като Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, подредени отляво надясно в този ред; за всяка категория има група от шест стълба. Вертикалната ос е означена „Accuracy (%)“ и използва линейна скала с видими стойности приблизително от 50 до 62, с равномерни деления през 2 процентни пункта (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Легендата в горната част указва шестте серии и визуалното им кодиране: DAPO+Self-reflection (плътен син стълб), DAPO (син с диагонално щрихиране), SRPO (плътен оранжев), GRPO (оранжев с диагонално щрихиране), PPO+Self-reflection (плътен зелен) и PPO (зелен с диагонално щрихиране). По групи се виждат приблизителни стойности: за Mathverse стълбовете са около 53.1 (DAPO), 56.1 (DAPO+Self-reflection), 55.8 (SRPO), 53.4 (GRPO), 54.5 (PPO+Self-reflection) и 53.3 (PPO); за MMLU са около 55.9, 56.9, 57.1, 55.8, 56.1 и 54.6 (в същия ред на сериите); за Physics са около 57.5, 61.0, 60.6, 58.0, 59.1 и 56.9. Стълбовете не изглеждат сортирани по височина, а са подредени по фиксиран ред на сериите в рамките на всяка група, като визуалното разграничаване се прави чрез цвят и щриховка без допълнително подчертаване (напр. контури или анотации).
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图展示了六种强化学习配置在三个基准任务（Mathverse、MMLU、Physics）上的准确率（Accuracy）表现，以便在同一坐标系下对不同方法在不同基准上的数值结果进行并列呈现。横轴为类别轴，按从左到右的顺序依次标注为 Mathverse、MMLU、Physics，每个类别下为一组并列柱；纵轴为数值轴，标签为“Accuracy (%)”，采用线性刻度，显示范围约为 50% 到 62%，刻度以 2 个百分点为等间隔（50、52、54、56、58、60、62）。每个基准内包含 6 根并列柱，柱在组内从左到右的视觉顺序为：DAPO（蓝色斜线填充）、DAPO+Self-reflection（纯蓝色）、GRPO（橙色斜线填充）、SRPO（纯橙色）、PPO（绿色斜线填充）、PPO+Self-reflection（纯绿色），图例位于图的上方并用颜色与斜线样式区分方法。就数值而言，Mathverse 组中 DAPO 约 53.1%、DAPO+Self-reflection 约 56.1%、GRPO 约 53.4%、SRPO 约 55.8%、PPO 约 53.3%、PPO+Self-reflection 约 54.5%；MMLU 组中 DAPO 约 55.9%、DAPO+Self-reflection 约 56.9%、GRPO 约 55.8%、SRPO 约 57.1%、PPO 约 54.6%、PPO+Self-reflection 约 56.2%；Physics 组中 DAPO 约 57.5%、DAPO+Self-reflection 约 61.0%、GRPO 约 58.1%、SRPO 约 60.6%、PPO 约 56.9%、PPO+Self-reflection 约 59.1%。图中未显示按数值大小重新排序的迹象（类别按基准名称固定排列，组内按方法固定排列），也未见单独的阴影、加粗轮廓或文字注释来对某一柱进行额外强调。
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates an accuracy (%) comparison across three benchmarks, showing grouped bars for six reinforcement learning configurations. The horizontal axis contains the benchmark categories in left-to-right order “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics,” and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 62, with regularly spaced tick marks every 2 percentage points. For each benchmark, six adjacent bars are shown in a consistent left-to-right arrangement: DAPO (light blue with diagonal hatching), DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (light orange with diagonal hatching), SRPO (solid orange), PPO (light green with diagonal hatching), and PPO+Self-reflection (solid green); the legend uses these same color/hatching encodings. In the Mathverse group, the bars are approximately DAPO ~53.1%, DAPO+Self-reflection ~56.1%, GRPO ~53.4%, SRPO ~55.8–55.9%, PPO ~53.3%, and PPO+Self-reflection ~54.5%. In the MMLU group, the bars are approximately DAPO ~55.9%, DAPO+Self-reflection ~56.9%, GRPO ~55.8%, SRPO ~57.1%, PPO ~54.6%, and PPO+Self-reflection ~56.2%. In the Physics group, the bars are approximately DAPO ~57.5%, DAPO+Self-reflection ~61.0%, GRPO ~58.1%, SRPO ~60.6%, PPO ~56.9%, and PPO+Self-reflection ~59.1%. The bars are not displayed in a descending or alphabetical sort by value; instead, they follow the fixed method order within each benchmark group, and there are no additional visual emphasis elements such as annotations or highlighted outlines beyond the color and hatching styles.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die Genauigkeit (Accuracy) in Prozent für sechs Reinforcement-Learning-Konfigurationen über drei Benchmarks dar und ordnet die Ergebnisse je Benchmark als nebeneinander gruppierte Balken an. Auf der horizontalen Achse stehen die Kategorien „Mathverse“, „MMLU“ und „Physics“ (von links nach rechts), während die vertikale Achse mit „Accuracy (%)“ beschriftet ist und eine lineare Skala von etwa 50 bis 62 zeigt, mit regelmäßig gesetzten Tick-Markierungen in 2er-Schritten (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Innerhalb jeder Benchmark-Gruppe sind sechs Balken von links nach rechts in der Reihenfolge DAPO (blau schraffiert), DAPO+Self-reflection (blau vollflächig), GRPO (orange schraffiert), SRPO (orange vollflächig), PPO (grün schraffiert) und PPO+Self-reflection (grün vollflächig) angeordnet; eine Legende oben links ordnet Farben und Schraffuren den Methoden zu. Für „Mathverse“ liegen die Balkenhöhen ungefähr bei 53,1 % (DAPO), 56,1 % (DAPO+Self-reflection), 53,4 % (GRPO), 55,8 % (SRPO), 53,3 % (PPO) und 54,5 % (PPO+Self-reflection). Für „MMLU“ sind es etwa 55,9 % (DAPO), 56,9 % (DAPO+Self-reflection), 55,8 % (GRPO), 57,1 % (SRPO), 54,6 % (PPO) und 56,2 % (PPO+Self-reflection). Für „Physics“ liegen die Werte ungefähr bei 57,5 % (DAPO), 61,0 % (DAPO+Self-reflection), 58,1 % (GRPO), 60,6 % (SRPO), 56,9 % (PPO) und 59,1 % (PPO+Self-reflection). Die Balken wirken weder zusätzlich markiert noch annotiert, und eine explizite Sortierung innerhalb der Benchmark-Gruppen ist über die feste Methodenreihenfolge hinaus nicht ersichtlich.
